icons.name: bell
icons.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The integrated top hanger is shortened by 0.5 unit (from 2.3 to 1.8 units above its shoulder junction) so it reads as a compact nub. The full drawing is then translated upward by 0.25 unit to keep opposite vertical margins balanced: centerline bounds y=2.75..21.25, visible Regular bounds y=1.9..22.1. Straight walls, shoulders, lower lip and clapper proportions are retained. No doubled seams. Review study; not owner-approved.

icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm. The left and right shoulders have explicit 3-unit horizontal ledges at y=6.8 (x=5..8 and x=16..19), with a narrower raised housing to keep both straight spans visible. The indicator is a zero-length segment centered at 17.9,9.5 with round caps, forming a solid circular dot whose diameter follows the stroke. This avoids the hollow-ring rendering of a tiny stroked circle under non-scaling preview strokes at high zoom. The circular lens is centered at 12,13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Camera Outline and Filled at source proportions.

icons.name: folder
icons.description: A horizontal rounded folder with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Owner-approved horizontal Folder. Single rounded outer contour with a straight front-panel edge at y=10.9. Bounds x=3..21, y=4.3..19.7; default stroke is 1.7, with visible left/right padding 2.15 and top/bottom 3.45. The approved X=100%, Y=110% geometry is baked into the path coordinates, preserving constant stroke width and the existing part names.

review.note: Owner approved both styles. Y scaling and constant stroke/gap have been baked into the source; the approved shape is now 100% in the Lab.

icons.name: heart
icons.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The lower silhouette is a slim V with only a slight outward convex bow. Mirrored quadratic flanks depart subtly from straight diagonals and meet a compact rounded tip. Tangents align through the side transitions and tip without inward inflections. The established upper lobes and notch are retained. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Heart Outline and Filled after the head alignment and centered-grid review. The reviewed Lab preview used X/Y=95%; these local preview settings are recorded without changing the source geometry.

icons.name: search
icons.description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The circular lens is an intentional silhouette exception. A single 45-degree handle meets the circle at its centerline, with a rounded free end. Combined centerline bounds x/y=3.3..20.7 balance the grid. Owner-approved source. Outline-only icon by owner direction; no Filled variant.

review.note: Owner approved Search Outline; Filled is intentionally omitted by owner direction.

icons.name: settings
icons.description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Six original radial teeth use straight faces with individually rounded transitions. The recognizable gear is a silhouette exception to the rounded rectangle baseline. Opposite teeth are constructed in symmetric pairs about 12,12; the circular hub remains circular. Owner-approved source.

review.note: Owner approved Settings Outline and Filled after aligning their exterior and hub. Reviewed in Lab at source proportions, Regular 1.70, including rotation 30 degrees.
